by
  -- Step 1: Use the fact that n is even to get the closure in ℚ
  let h1 : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℚ :=
    Rat.addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow n (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) hn
  -- Step 2: Show that non-negative integers are contained in the closure
  have h2 : AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ ⊆ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) :=
    Set.subset.antisymm (AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℤ_subset_nonneg_ℚ) (AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℚ_subset_closure)
  -- Step 3: Show that the closure is contained in the non-negative integers
  have h3 : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) ⊆ AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ :=
    Set.subset.antisymm (AddSubmonoid.closure_subset_nonneg_ℚ) (AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℚ_subset_nonneg_ℤ)
  -- Step 4: Conclude by equality of sets
  exact Set.ext (h2.trans h3)
